ucs.title: [LLM] Volt Typhoon NTDS.dit theft via ntdsutil IFM + shadow-copy abuse on domain controllers
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Volt Typhoon (Vanguard Panda / VOLTZITE) domain credential heist: invoking ntdsutil.exe with the Install-From-Media (IFM) flags to dump NTDS.dit, or staging the AD database off a vssadmin/wmic shadow copy with esentutl/robocopy. CISA AA24-038A flags this exact LOTL chain as Volt Typhoon's preferred method for harvesting Active Directory hashes off compromised US critical-infrastructure DCs.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name=ntdsutil.exe AND (Processes.process="*ifm*" OR Processes.process="*create full*" OR Processes.process="*activate instance ntds*")) OR (Processes.process_name=vssadmin.exe AND Processes.process="*create shadow*") OR (Processes.process_name=wmic.exe AND Processes.process="*shadowcopy*" AND Processes.process="*create*") OR (Processes.process_name IN (esentutl.exe,robocopy.exe,xcopy.exe) AND (Processes.process="*ntds.dit*" OR Processes.process="*HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user,"\$$") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
let NtdsIfm = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("ifm", "create full", "activate instance ntds", "create database", "create sysvol");
let ShadowStage = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "create" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadow")
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "create")
         or (FileName in~ ("esentutl.exe","robocopy.exe","xcopy.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("ntds.dit","HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy"));
union NtdsIfm, ShadowStage
| where AccountName !endswith "$"        // exclude machine-account scheduled backup tasks
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("wbengine.exe","NTBackup.exe")  // exclude documented backup tooling
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where (NewProcessName endswith "\\ntdsutil.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("ifm","create full","activate instance ntds","create database","create sysvol"))
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has "create" and CommandLine has "shadow")
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\wmic.exe" and CommandLine has "shadowcopy" and CommandLine has "create")
     or (NewProcessName has_any ("\\esentutl.exe","\\robocopy.exe","\\xcopy.exe") and CommandLine has_any ("ntds.dit","HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy"))
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"     // exclude SYSTEM-context backup tasks
| where ParentProcessName !has_any ("wbengine.exe","NTBackup.exe")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Volt Typhoon NTDS.dit Extraction via ntdsutil IFM
id: 7e2a6a8c-1c30-4b56-a3e9-7c0f1f4e3b21
status: experimental
description: Detects ntdsutil.exe invoked with Install-From-Media (IFM) parameters to dump the NTDS.dit Active Directory database — the signature Volt Typhoon (G1017) DC credential-heist TTP called out in CISA AA24-038A.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-038a
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1017/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/18
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.003
  - attack.g1017
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\ntdsutil.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'ifm'
      - 'create full'
      - 'activate instance ntds'
  filter_backup:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\wbengine.exe'
      - '\NTBackup.exe'
  condition: selection_img and selection_cmd and not filter_backup
falsepositives:
  - Documented disaster-recovery / DC migration with change ticket
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.security @EventID:4688 (@Image:(*\\ntdsutil.exe OR *\\Ntdsutil.exe OR *\\NTDSUTIL.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*ifm* OR *"create full"* OR *"activate instance ntds"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"create shadow"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\esentutl.exe OR *\\EsentUtl.exe OR *\\ESENTUTL.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*ntds.dit* OR *NTDS.dit* OR *HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\ntdsutil\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(ifm|create\s+full|activate\s+instance\s+ntds|create\s+database)/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/create\s+shadow/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/shadowcopy/i AND CommandLine=/create/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\(esentutl|robocopy|xcopy)\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(ntds\.dit|HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy)/i)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen)])
| sort(lastSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Volt Typhoon is publicly documented (CISA AA24-038A, Microsoft, Mandiant) as preferring ntdsutil IFM and shadow-copy NTDS.dit extraction over Mimikatz/lsass dumping because it avoids AV signatures and lives entirely off built-in Microsoft tooling — a deliberate choice tied to their long-dwell critical-infrastructure mission. ucs.title: [LLM] Volt Typhoon netsh portproxy relay listener for KV-botnet / SOHO-router C2 fan-in
ucs.description: Hunts a Volt Typhoon-characteristic LOTL persistence/relay step: invoking netsh.exe to add a v4tov4 portproxy listener on a compromised intranet host so that inbound traffic from the KV-botnet / compromised SOHO-router relay network is forwarded onto another internal asset. CISA, NSA, and Microsoft Threat Intelligence Center (which clusters this actor as DEV-0391 / Vanguard Panda) all single this command out as a hallmark of the actor's network-tunneling tradecraft.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name=netsh.exe Processes.process="*portproxy*" (Processes.process="*add v4tov4*" OR Processes.process="*add v4tov6*" OR Processes.process="*add v6tov4*" OR Processes.process="*add v6tov6*" OR Processes.process="*set v4tov4*") by Processes.dest Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user,"\$$") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where FileName =~ "netsh.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has "portproxy"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("add v4tov4","add v4tov6","add v6tov4","add v6tov6","set v4tov4")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"   // exclude SYSTEM/machine-account context
| extend ListenPort = extract(@"(?i)listenport\s*=\s*([0-9]+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend ConnectAddress = extract(@"(?i)connectaddress\s*=\s*([0-9a-fA-F\.:]+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend ConnectPort = extract(@"(?i)connectport\s*=\s*([0-9]+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine,
          ListenPort, ConnectAddress, ConnectPort,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          GrandparentImage = InitiatingProcessParentFileName
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\netsh.exe"
| where CommandLine has "portproxy"
| where CommandLine has_any ("add v4tov4","add v4tov6","add v6tov4","add v6tov6","set v4tov4")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend ListenPort = extract(@"(?i)listenport\s*=\s*([0-9]+)", 1, CommandLine)
| extend ConnectAddress = extract(@"(?i)connectaddress\s*=\s*([0-9a-fA-F\.:]+)", 1, CommandLine)
| extend ConnectPort = extract(@"(?i)connectport\s*=\s*([0-9]+)", 1, CommandLine)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine,
          ListenPort, ConnectAddress, ConnectPort, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Volt Typhoon netsh portproxy Relay Listener
id: c8d7f4a2-9b15-4d23-8b6e-8d7e2a1f5c44
status: experimental
description: Detects netsh.exe configuring an IPv4/IPv6 port-forwarding (portproxy) listener — a signature Volt Typhoon (G1017) LOTL technique used to relay C2 traffic from the KV-botnet / SOHO-router proxy network through compromised intranet pivot hosts.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-038a
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2023/05/24/volt-typhoon-targets-us-critical-infrastructure-with-living-off-the-land-techniques/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/18
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1090.001
  - attack.g1017
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\netsh.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'portproxy'
  selection_action:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'add v4tov4'
      - 'add v4tov6'
      - 'add v6tov4'
      - 'add v6tov6'
      - 'set v4tov4'
  condition: selection and selection_action
falsepositives:
  - Documented network-admin port-forwarding configuration with change ticket
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.security @EventID:4688 @Image:(*\\netsh.exe OR *\\Netsh.exe OR *\\NETSH.EXE) @CommandLine:(*portproxy*) @CommandLine:(*"add v4tov4"* OR *"add v4tov6"* OR *"add v6tov4"* OR *"add v6tov6"* OR *"set v4tov4"*) -@SubjectUserName:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\netsh\.exe$/i
| CommandLine=/portproxy/i
| CommandLine=/(add\s+v4tov4|add\s+v4tov6|add\s+v6tov4|add\s+v6tov6|set\s+v4tov4)/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| ListenPort := regex("(?i)listenport\s*=\s*(?<ListenPort>[0-9]+)", field=CommandLine, strict=false)
| ConnectAddress := regex("(?i)connectaddress\s*=\s*(?<ConnectAddress>[0-9a-fA-F\.:]+)", field=CommandLine, strict=false)
| ConnectPort := regex("(?i)connectport\s*=\s*(?<ConnectPort>[0-9]+)", field=CommandLine, strict=false)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ListenPort, ConnectAddress, ConnectPort], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen)])
| sort(lastSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Volt Typhoon's KV-botnet of compromised Cisco/Netgear/DrayTek SOHO routers terminates at internal Windows pivots that the actor turns into TCP relays with `netsh interface portproxy add v4tov4 listenport=X connectport=Y connectaddress=Z` — the exact command form CISA reproduces in AA24-038A and that Microsoft documents under the DEV-0391 / Vanguard Panda cluster. Legitimate enterprise use of netsh
